Basic Guidelines:

8 total towers will spawn.
5 or 6 out around the edge
3 or 2 in the middle intercards

North/South Prey players 
want to soak towers that are 
directly across from eachother, 
or at least have one of them 
soak a middle tower. 
This ensures enough space to 
comfortably place meteors.

"Cursed Pattern".

As soon as the first towers 
resolve, the prey players 
should begin rotating 
clockwise around the edge
of the arena.

As they move, they will each 
drop 7 meteors. If any meteor
is placed to close to another, 
it will explode and wipe the raid.

If the prey players are 180º 
away from each other, they 
can simply hold forward and 
move until all meteors 
are dropped.

If they are 120º away, 
this is known as a 
"Cursed Pattern".
The Player with more space 
should try to give the cursed 
player as much space 
as possible by positioning 
on the edge of their tower.

The cursed player can 
successfully drop all 7 meteors
in that space with careful
movement, pausing breifly 
every 1s or so, or  with help
from a movement macro.

This is difficult to execute 
and can be taken as a 
"bonus pull!" if done 
successfully. So do not 
stress about achieveing this 
every time.
